name: Zachary Stoor
bio:
Zac joined the Bertelsmann Foundation in February 2025 as a Project Coordinator of Transatlantic Relations. Zac supports the Transatlantic Barometer and Transatlantic Periscope platforms and conducts research on democracy in the transatlantic space. Prior to joining the Bertelsmann Foundation, Zac has worked for the National Democratic Institute, U.S. Helsinki Commission, and the U.S. Department of State, primarily focusing on democracy and human rights issues in Europe.
 
Zac holds an M.A. in European Studies and a Certificate in Russian and Eurasian Studies from Georgetown University's School of Foreign Service. His graduate research focused on democratic backsliding in Central and Eastern Europe and its effects on EU enlargement. Zac also holds a B.A. in Political Science from Stanford University. He is proficient in French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, and German.
